name: Yeles (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided red over green with a white triangle at the hoist bearing the crowned arms of Yeles (a cross on green, a cross on blue and grapes).
history: Municipal flag of Yeles; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle with its base at the hoist and its apex at the centre
Yeles arms — cross on green, cross on blue and grapes on red
